name: html.template
doc:
HTML templates: the text.template engine with contextual
auto-escaping (see text.template's htmlctx.zl). Values of the
HTML, URL and JS types are trusted and inserted as they are where
their kind of content is expected.

items.name: ParseNamed
items.signature: func ParseNamed<T>(name string, src string) text.template.Template<T>!

items.name: ParseWith
items.signature: func ParseWith<T>(src string, funcs map[string]func([]text.template.Value) text.template.Value!) text.template.Template<T>!

items.name: HTML
items.doc: Trusted HTML markup (not escaped in text context).
items.summary: Trusted HTML markup (not escaped in text context).

items.name: JS
items.doc: A trusted JS expression (inserted as is in scripts).
items.summary: A trusted JS expression (inserted as is in scripts).

items.name: URL
items.doc: A trusted URL (its scheme is not filtered).
items.summary: A trusted URL (its scheme is not filtered).
